operation: UI concept over approved hill reference

request.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: frozen Phase 2 HUD concept for Athen Hill, an original early-2000s science-fiction MMO homage.
Input image 1 is the approved environment reference and edit target: preserve its entire city image, camera framing, giant tree silhouette, architecture, people, sunset lighting and colours exactly. Add ONLY the flat game HUD over it. Output one complete 16:9 landscape game-screen concept, not a presentation sheet or a device mockup.
UI style: original 2001 MMO interface, compact dark gunmetal translucent panels, very thin muted cyan hairlines, modest chamfered corners and subtly beveled metal edges. Restrained dusty, worn material cues. Clean legible off-white small interface type; no neon bloom, modern glassmorphism, pill buttons, dashboard cards, large logo, or copied existing-game interface.
Composition: Keep at least 70 percent of the scene entirely unobscured. The huge tree crown, trunk, mound and steps remain the focal subject and mostly free of UI. Place all dense controls near the outer margins with 20 px edge clearance.
Left edge at upper-middle: two narrow vertical status meters in a slim dark instrument housing, vitality in muted red and nano in desaturated cyan, short legible labels. Nothing extends over the central tree.
Bottom center: exactly six distinct square beveled hotbar slots, numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, with tiny restrained original flask, medical pouch, wrist-terminal icons and empty inactive slots. Keep the hotbar short and only one row high.
Bottom left: one small shallow translucent chat panel. Readable text exactly: "Linn: Meet me on the hill." No other chat copy is required.
Center foreground paving: a tiny simple cyan bracket cursor, four right-angle corners only, without a sword, circle or weapon imagery.
Right edge around lower-middle: one compact shop window, narrow enough that it does not cover the central tree and hill steps. Original thin metal frame, header "Basic General", a subtle close X. Two item rows with small original icons and exactly these labels: "Water Flask" and "Medkit". Select Water Flask with a restrained cyan border. At the bottom, two compact rectangular controls labelled "Buy" and "Sell". No large pop-up, no nested cards, no promotional text.
Exact visible text: "Vitality", "Nano", "Linn: Meet me on the hill.", "Basic General", "Water Flask", "Medkit", "Buy", "Sell", and hotbar numerals 1 through 6. Use correct spelling and readable alignment.
Constraints: original title/world; no Funcom, Anarchy Online, Clan or Omni logos or interface copies. Do not change the environment image. No watermarks, spec labels, artboard borders, UI annotations, or extra title block. This is the HUD art direction reference only.
